lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-ordered grid of high-luminance circular local maxima arranged in approximately four identifiable longitudinal rows along the lateral flank posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the longitudinal rows, with high-luminance blobs positioned at these grid-like intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature situated on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient exhibiting high intensity on the dorsal aspect and shadow on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple low-luminance elongated silhouettes (likely commensal fish) are visible trailing the ventral margin of the pectoral fin and the ventral midline.
